name: io.github.tonyyang0504/vidaxl_dropshipping-mcp
description: vidaXL B2B dropshipping (dropshippingxl.com offline → b2b.vidaxl.com) (ecommerce suppliers): me, lis

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_VIDAXL_DROPSHIPPING_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: The vidaXL B2B customer e-mail (HTTP Basic username).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_VIDAXL_DROPSHIPPING_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token shown under MY ACCOUNT on b2b.vidaxl.com (HTTP Basic password). Sandbox tokens belong to https://sandbox.b2b.vidaxl.com, which this server does not switch to.
